group.mention.aiBadge.description: Small badge beside Homeroom's assistant in the list of people offered while typing @ in a chat message. Short for artificial intelligence; it marks the entry as not a person.

group.mention.you.description: Small tag beside the person's own username in the list of people offered while typing @ in a chat message. Lower case, it follows the username.

group.emojiMenu.heading.description: Heading of the list of emoji offered while typing a shortcode such as :smile in a chat message. {{query}} is what the person typed so far, with its leading colon, for example :smi. Keep the <0> tags around it.

group.emojiMenu.label.description: Accessible name of the list of emoji offered while typing a shortcode in a chat message.

group.composer.replyingTo.description: Line above the message box in a community chat while the person is writing a reply to an earlier message. {{name}} is whose message it is: an @username, or a label such as a proposal's name. Keep the arrow first.

group.composer.cancelReply.description: Accessible name of the ✕ button beside the 'Replying to' line above the chat message box: the message stops being a reply.

group.composer.attachFiles.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the paperclip button beside the chat message box: opens the file chooser to add files to the message.

group.composer.send.description: Label, tooltip and accessible name of the button that sends the chat message the person typed. Send is a verb.

group.composer.page.attachFiles.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the + button beside the reply box at the foot of a request's or a change's page: opens the file chooser to add files to the reply.

group.composer.page.reply.description: Accessible name of the reply box at the foot of a request's or a change's page, where the person writes a reply to it. A noun: the reply being written.

group.composer.page.send.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the round arrow button beside the reply box at the foot of a request's or a change's page: sends the reply the person typed. A verb.

group.composer.placeholder.description: Placeholder inside the empty message box of a community's channel.

group.readOnly.devSpace.text: You’re viewing this app’s dev space read-only. Only collaborators can post.
group.readOnly.devSpace.description: Notice in place of the message box in a project's channel when the person may read it but not write. 'Dev space' is the project's area for building; 'post' is a verb, to send a message.

group.specPanel.resize.description: Accessible name of the draggable divider between the chat and the side panel that shows a spec (the written description of a change).

group.postedVia.title.text: Posted by a coding agent on this person's behalf
group.postedVia.title.description: Tooltip of the 'via agent' chip beside a message's author: the message was sent by that person's AI coding agent, not typed by them. Posted is a verb form, to post a message.

group.postedVia.chip.description: Small chip beside a message's author when the person's AI coding agent sent the message for them. Lower case; it follows the author's name.

group.quiet.change.nobody.text: Nobody has commented on this change yet
group.quiet.change.nobody.description: Heading of the card shown in the empty discussion of a proposed change that has never had a comment. 'Change' is a noun: a proposed change to a project.

group.quiet.change.lately.text: It has been quiet on this change lately
group.quiet.change.lately.description: Heading of the card shown in the discussion of a proposed change when there are no recent comments to show. 'Change' is a noun: a proposed change to a project.

group.quiet.app.nobody.text: Nobody has said anything here yet
group.quiet.app.nobody.description: Heading of the card shown in a project's channel that has never had a message.

group.quiet.app.lately.text: It has been quiet in here lately
group.quiet.app.lately.description: Heading of the card shown in a project's channel when there are no recent messages to show.

group.quiet.change.invite.text: 👋 Ask a question, or say what you think of it.
group.quiet.change.invite.description: Line under the heading of the empty-discussion card of a proposed change, for a person who may comment. 'It' is the change. Keep the waving hand first.

group.quiet.change.readOnly.text: Comments from the group will show up here.
group.quiet.change.readOnly.description: Line under the heading of the empty-discussion card of a proposed change, for a person who may read but not comment. 'The group' is the project's community.

group.quiet.app.invite.text: 👋 Say hi, ask a question, or share what you would like to see next in {{app}}.
group.quiet.app.invite.description: Line under the heading of the empty-channel card of a project, for a person who may write. {{app}} is the project's name. Keep the waving hand first.

group.quiet.app.readOnly.text: Messages from the people building {{app}} will show up here.
group.quiet.app.readOnly.description: Line under the heading of the empty-channel card of a project, for a person who may read but not write. {{app}} is the project's name.

group.reactionBar.moreEmoji.description: Accessible name of the ＋ button on the reaction bar that appears on a touched chat message: opens the full grid of emoji to react with.

group.reactionBar.edit.description: Accessible name of the pencil button on the reaction bar that appears on the person's own chat message on a touch screen: starts editing that message.

group.reactionBar.report.description: Button on the reaction bar that appears on someone else's chat message: reports the message to the moderators. Report is a verb.

group.starters.label.description: Accessible name of the row of suggested first messages above the message box of a channel the person has not written in yet.

group.starters.hi.description: Suggested first message above a channel's message box. Tapping it puts exactly this text in the message box; it is not sent until the person sends it. Keep the waving hand.

group.starters.loveIt.description: Suggested first message above a channel's message box. Tapping it puts exactly this text in the message box. 'It' is the project the channel belongs to.

group.starters.couldItAlso.description: Chip above a channel's message box that starts a suggestion for the project. Tapping it puts the beginning of this sentence in the message box for the person to finish. 'It' is the project.

group.starters.couldItAlsoText.description: The beginning of a sentence put in the message box when the person taps the 'Could it also…' chip; they type the rest. 'It' is the project. No ellipsis and no final punctuation: the person's own words follow it.

group.spec.sections.description: Accessible name of the two tabs (User-facing, Technical) at the top of a spec shown in the chat's side panel. A spec is the written description of a change.

group.spec.tab.user.description: Tab of a spec in the chat's side panel: the part that describes what people using the project will see.

group.spec.tab.tech.description: Tab of a spec in the chat's side panel: the part that describes how the change is built.

group.spec.tabEmpty.description: Shown under a spec's User-facing or Technical tab in the chat's side panel when that part of the spec is empty.

group.spec.copy.label.description: Button in the header of the spec side panel: copies the whole spec to the clipboard as Markdown text. Copy is a verb.

group.spec.copy.title.text: Copy the whole spec as markdown
group.spec.copy.title.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the 'Copy markdown' button in the header of the spec side panel.

group.spec.copy.copied.description: Replaces the 'Copy markdown' button's label for a moment after the spec was copied to the clipboard.

group.spec.copy.failed.description: Replaces the 'Copy markdown' button's label for a moment when the spec could not be copied to the clipboard.

group.spec.copy.failedToast.text: Couldn’t copy. Select the text and copy it manually
group.spec.copy.failedToast.description: Brief notice shown when the spec could not be copied to the clipboard from the spec side panel.

group.spec.close.description: Accessible name of the × button in the header of the spec side panel: closes the panel. Close is a verb.

group.botChip.reading.text: Homeroom bot is looking at this
group.botChip.reading.description: Status chip under a chat message that asked Homeroom bot for something, seen by everyone in the channel: the bot has taken the message and is reading it. Homeroom bot is the product's assistant that builds changes; keep its name.

group.botChip.building.description: Status chip under a chat message that asked Homeroom bot for something, seen by everyone in the channel: the bot is building the change that was asked for. Homeroom bot is the product's assistant that builds changes; keep its name.

group.botChip.fixing.description: Status chip under a chat message that asked Homeroom bot to fix one of its changes, seen by everyone in the channel: the bot is working on the fix. Homeroom bot is the product's assistant that builds changes; keep its name.

group.botChip.hasThis.description: Status chip under a chat message that asked Homeroom bot for something while the project's first version is not live yet: the bot has taken the request and has not started. Homeroom bot is the product's assistant that builds changes; keep its name.

group.botChip.hasThisSaid.text: Homeroom bot has this, and starts on it once the first version is live
group.botChip.hasThisSaid.description: What a screen reader says for the 'Homeroom bot has this' status chip under a chat message: the bot took the request and waits for the project's first version to go live. Homeroom bot is the product's assistant that builds changes; keep its name.

group.botChip.live.description: Status chip under a chat message that asked Homeroom bot for something: the change that was built is now live, in use in the project. An adjective.

group.botChip.liveSaid.text: Homeroom bot built this, and it’s live
group.botChip.liveSaid.description: What a screen reader says for the 'Live' status chip under a chat message: the bot built what the message asked for and the change is in use. Homeroom bot is the product's assistant that builds changes; keep its name.

group.botChip.tryIt.description: Chip under a chat message that asked Homeroom bot for something, once the change is built: opens a preview of the change so anyone can try it out. 'It' is the change.

group.botCard.label.text: Homeroom bot, only you can see this
group.botCard.label.description: Accessible name of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message. Nobody else in the channel sees the card. Homeroom bot is the product's assistant that builds changes; keep its name.

group.botCard.onlyYou.description: Small heading at the top of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: nobody else in the channel sees the card.

group.botCard.shared.text: Everyone here can see Homeroom bot has it.
group.botCard.shared.description: Line on Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, just after a request was taken: the status chip on their message is visible to the whole channel. 'It' is the request. Homeroom bot is the product's assistant that builds changes; keep its name.

group.botCard.choices.description: Accessible name of the row of buttons on Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message.

group.botCard.withStays.text: {{words}} It stays in the project’s requests with your name on it.
group.botCard.withStays.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message on the person's first request in a project. {{words}} is the complete sentence or sentences the card says about the request, for example 'Got it: Add dark mode.'; this adds that the request stays listed in the project's requests under their name. 'Requests' is a noun: the project's list of things people asked for.

group.botCard.approval.has.text: It has the approvals it needs.
group.botCard.approval.has.description: Sentence on Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, after 'Built: …': the change has been approved by enough people. 'It' is the change.

group.botCard.approval.needs_one.description: Sentence on Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, after 'Built: …', saying how many approvals the built change still needs and who can give them (any of the people listed will do). "Needs" is a verb whose subject, the change, is left out. {{count}} is the number of approvals; the singular form spells it out as "one". {{people}} is a list of people, for example "you, @ada or @ben": the word for the reader, account names, and sometimes "2 others".

group.botCard.approval.needs_other.description: Sentence on Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, after 'Built: …', saying how many approvals the built change still needs and who can give them (any of the people listed will do). "Needs" is a verb whose subject, the change, is left out. {{count}} is the number of approvals; the singular form spells it out as "one". {{people}} is a list of people, for example "you, @ada or @ben": the word for the reader, account names, and sometimes "2 others".

group.botCard.approval.needsMore_one.description: Sentence on Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, after 'Built: …', saying how many more approvals the built change needs, once it has some, and who can give them (any of the people listed will do). "Needs" is a verb whose subject, the change, is left out. {{count}} is the number still missing; the singular form spells it out as "one". {{people}} is a list of people, for example "you, @ada or @ben": the word for the reader, account names, and sometimes "2 others".

group.botCard.approval.needsMore_other.description: Sentence on Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, after 'Built: …', saying how many more approvals the built change needs, once it has some, and who can give them (any of the people listed will do). "Needs" is a verb whose subject, the change, is left out. {{count}} is the number still missing; the singular form spells it out as "one". {{people}} is a list of people, for example "you, @ada or @ben": the word for the reader, account names, and sometimes "2 others".

group.botCard.approval.waitingFrom.description: Sentence on Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, after 'Built: …', saying that every person listed still has to approve the built change. {{people}} is a list joined with "and", for example "you, @ada and 2 more".

group.botCard.approval.waiting.description: Sentence on Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, after 'Built: …': the change still needs approval and nobody in particular is named.

group.botCard.filed.firstVersionWait.text: Got it: {{title}}. Waiting for the first version to go live. I’ll start on this as soon as it does.
group.botCard.filed.firstVersionWait.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the bot took the request and will start once the project's first version is live. {{title}} is the request's title, in the person's own words. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.firstVersionWaitUnti.text: Got it: your request. Waiting for the first version to go live. I’ll start on this as soon as it does.
group.botCard.filed.firstVersionWaitUnti.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the bot took the request and will start once the project's first version is live. Used when the request has no title, so it is called 'your request'. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.waitingBuilder.text: Got it: {{title}}. Waiting for a free builder.
group.botCard.filed.waitingBuilder.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the bot took the request and it waits in line; a 'builder' is one of the workers that build changes. {{title}} is the request's title, in the person's own words. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.waitingBuilderUntitl.text: Got it: your request. Waiting for a free builder.
group.botCard.filed.waitingBuilderUntitl.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the bot took the request and it waits in line; a 'builder' is one of the workers that build changes. Used when the request has no title, so it is called 'your request'. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.building.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the bot is building the change that was asked for. {{title}} is the request's title, in the person's own words. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.buildingUntitled.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the bot is building the change that was asked for. Used when the request has no title, so it is called 'your request'. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.checking.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the change is built and its tests are running. {{title}} is the request's title, in the person's own words. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.checkingUntitled.text: Built: your request. Testing it now.
group.botCard.filed.checkingUntitled.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the change is built and its tests are running. Used when the request has no title, so it is called 'your request'. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.proposed.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the change is built and waits for approval. {{title}} is the request's title, in the person's own words. {{approval}} is a complete sentence, already in the reader's language, saying who still has to approve it, for example 'Waiting for approval from you and @ada.' The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.proposedUntitled.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the change is built and waits for approval. Used when the request has no title, so it is called 'your request'. {{approval}} is a complete sentence, already in the reader's language, saying who still has to approve it, for example 'Waiting for approval from you and @ada.' The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.approved.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the change was approved and is being released; 'going live' means becoming the version people use. {{title}} is the request's title, in the person's own words. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.approvedUntitled.text: Approved: your request. It’s going live.
group.botCard.filed.approvedUntitled.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the change was approved and is being released; 'going live' means becoming the version people use. Used when the request has no title, so it is called 'your request'. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.live.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the change that was asked for is now in use. {{title}} is the request's title, in the person's own words. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.liveUntitled.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the change that was asked for is now in use. Used when the request has no title, so it is called 'your request'. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.closed.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the change was closed without being released. Closed is an adjective here. {{title}} is the request's title, in the person's own words. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.closedUntitled.text: Closed: your request. It won’t go live.
group.botCard.filed.closedUntitled.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the change was closed without being released. Closed is an adjective here. Used when the request has no title, so it is called 'your request'. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.gotIt.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the bot took the request. {{title}} is the request's title, in the person's own words. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.gotItUntitled.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the bot took the request. Used when the request has no title, so it is called 'your request'. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.gotItMinutes_one.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the bot took the request, and how long a change like it usually takes. {{title}} is the request's title, in the person's own words; {{count}} is a number of minutes.

group.botCard.filed.gotItMinutesUntitled.text: Got it: your request. Usually about {{count}} minutes.
group.botCard.filed.gotItMinutesUntitled.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the bot took the request, and how long a change like it usually takes. Used when the request has no title. {{count}} is a number of minutes.

group.botCard.filed.gotItMinutes_other.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the bot took the request, and how long a change like it usually takes. {{title}} is the request's title, in the person's own words; {{count}} is a number of minutes.

group.botCard.filed.gotItMinutesUntitled.text: Got it: your request. Usually about {{count}} minutes.
group.botCard.filed.gotItMinutesUntitled.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the bot took the request, and how long a change like it usually takes. Used when the request has no title. {{count}} is a number of minutes.

group.botCard.filed.question.text: I have a question about this. It’s in our chat.
group.botCard.filed.question.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: before building, the bot asked the person something in their private chat with it. The bot speaks as 'I'; 'our chat' is that private conversation.

group.botCard.filed.person.text: I left this for the group to decide.
group.botCard.filed.person.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the bot did not build the request and left it as a request for the project's community to decide on. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.filed.stopped.text: I couldn’t finish this. Our chat says why.
group.botCard.filed.stopped.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: the bot stopped before finishing the change; the reason is in the person's private chat with the bot. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.revise.checking.firstVersi.text: Updated the first version. Testing it now.
group.botCard.revise.checking.firstVersi.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, when the message asked for a fix to a change the bot built that is still waiting for approval: the fix was added to the change and its tests are running. The change is the project's first version. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.revise.checking.titled.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, when the message asked for a fix to a change the bot built that is still waiting for approval: the fix was added to the change and its tests are running. {{title}} is the change's title; keep the quotation marks around it. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.revise.checking.untitled.text: Updated that change. Testing it now.
group.botCard.revise.checking.untitled.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, when the message asked for a fix to a change the bot built that is still waiting for approval: the fix was added to the change and its tests are running. Used when the change has no title. 'Change' is a noun: a proposed change to the project. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.revise.proposed.firstVersi.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, when the message asked for a fix to a change the bot built that is still waiting for approval: the fix was added and the change waits for approval. The change is the project's first version. {{approval}} is a complete sentence, already in the reader's language, saying who still has to approve it, for example 'Waiting for approval from you and @ada.' The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.revise.proposed.titled.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, when the message asked for a fix to a change the bot built that is still waiting for approval: the fix was added and the change waits for approval. {{title}} is the change's title; keep the quotation marks around it. {{approval}} is a complete sentence, already in the reader's language, saying who still has to approve it, for example 'Waiting for approval from you and @ada.' The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.revise.proposed.untitled.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, when the message asked for a fix to a change the bot built that is still waiting for approval: the fix was added and the change waits for approval. Used when the change has no title. 'Change' is a noun: a proposed change to the project. {{approval}} is a complete sentence, already in the reader's language, saying who still has to approve it, for example 'Waiting for approval from you and @ada.' The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.revise.asked.firstVersion.text: I have a question about your fix. It’s in the discussion of the first version.
group.botCard.revise.asked.firstVersion.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, when the message asked for a fix to a change the bot built that is still waiting for approval: the bot asked the person something about the fix, in that change's discussion. The change is the project's first version. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.revise.asked.titled.text: I have a question about your fix. It’s in the discussion of “{{title}}”.
group.botCard.revise.asked.titled.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, when the message asked for a fix to a change the bot built that is still waiting for approval: the bot asked the person something about the fix, in that change's discussion. {{title}} is the change's title; keep the quotation marks around it. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.revise.asked.untitled.text: I have a question about your fix. It’s in the discussion of that change.
group.botCard.revise.asked.untitled.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, when the message asked for a fix to a change the bot built that is still waiting for approval: the bot asked the person something about the fix, in that change's discussion. Used when the change has no title. 'Change' is a noun: a proposed change to the project. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.revise.answered.firstVersi.text: I answered you in the discussion of the first version.
group.botCard.revise.answered.firstVersi.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, when the message asked for a fix to a change the bot built that is still waiting for approval: the bot replied to the person in that change's discussion instead of changing anything. The change is the project's first version. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.revise.answered.titled.text: I answered you in the discussion of “{{title}}”.
group.botCard.revise.answered.titled.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, when the message asked for a fix to a change the bot built that is still waiting for approval: the bot replied to the person in that change's discussion instead of changing anything. {{title}} is the change's title; keep the quotation marks around it. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.revise.answered.untitled.text: I answered you in the discussion of that change.
group.botCard.revise.answered.untitled.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, when the message asked for a fix to a change the bot built that is still waiting for approval: the bot replied to the person in that change's discussion instead of changing anything. Used when the change has no title. 'Change' is a noun: a proposed change to the project. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.revise.person.firstVersion.text: I left your fix to the first version for the group to decide.
group.botCard.revise.person.firstVersion.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, when the message asked for a fix to a change the bot built that is still waiting for approval: the bot did not make the fix and left it for the project's community to decide. The change is the project's first version. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.revise.person.titled.text: I left your fix to “{{title}}” for the group to decide.
group.botCard.revise.person.titled.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, when the message asked for a fix to a change the bot built that is still waiting for approval: the bot did not make the fix and left it for the project's community to decide. {{title}} is the change's title; keep the quotation marks around it. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.revise.person.untitled.text: I left your fix to that change for the group to decide.
group.botCard.revise.person.untitled.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, when the message asked for a fix to a change the bot built that is still waiting for approval: the bot did not make the fix and left it for the project's community to decide. Used when the change has no title. 'Change' is a noun: a proposed change to the project. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.revise.approved.firstVersi.text: The first version was approved. It’s going live.
group.botCard.revise.approved.firstVersi.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, when the message asked for a fix to a change the bot built that is still waiting for approval: the change was approved and is being released; 'going live' means becoming the version people use. The change is the project's first version. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.revise.approved.titled.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, when the message asked for a fix to a change the bot built that is still waiting for approval: the change was approved and is being released; 'going live' means becoming the version people use. {{title}} is the change's title; keep the quotation marks around it. group.botCard.offer.description: Question on Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, for a newcomer whose message reads like an idea for the project: offers to add it to the project's list of requests. {{title}} is the title the request would get; keep the quotation marks around it.

group.botCard.offerUntitled.text: Suggest this to the group? It goes in the project’s requests, in your name.

group.botCard.unsureTitled.text: Want me to file this as a request? {{title}}

group.botCard.question.description: Text of Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, when the message was a question rather than a request to build something: the bot answers in the person's private chat with it. The bot speaks as 'I'.

group.botCard.failed.text: I couldn’t file it just now. Try again in a minute.

group.botCard.action.seeRequest.description: Button on Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message: opens the request as it is listed in the project's requests. 'Request' is a noun.

group.botCard.action.seeProgress.description: Button on Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, while the bot is working: opens the person's private chat with Homeroom bot, where the progress of the build is shown.

group.botCard.action.fileIt.description: Button on Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, answering 'Want me to file this as a request?': records the message as a request to build. 'File' is a verb, to record.

group.botCard.action.notNow.description: Button on Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, answering the card's offer to file or suggest the message as a request: declines and removes the card.

group.botCard.action.suggestIt.description: Button on Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, answering 'Suggest this to the group?': adds the idea to the project's list of requests in the person's name.

group.botCard.action.tryAgain.description: Button on Homeroom bot's private card under the person's own chat message, after recording the request failed: tries to record it again.

group.names.next.description: Joins people's usernames into a list, as in 'alice, bob and carol'. {{names}} is the names listed so far and {{name}} the next one, which is not the last. Only the punctuation between them is translated.

group.names.last.description: Ends a list of people's usernames, as in 'alice and bob' or 'alice, bob and carol'. {{names}} is the names listed so far and {{name}} is the last one.

group.credits.built.description: Sentence that names who made a change that went live, on an activity line or the weekly summary in a project's channel. {{author}} is the username of the person who built it.

group.credits.builtBacked.description: Sentence that names who made a change that went live, on an activity line or the weekly summary in a project's channel. {{author}} is the username of the person who built it; {{backers}} is the list of usernames of the people who voted for it, already joined.

group.credits.builtShaped.description: Sentence that names who made a change that went live, on an activity line or the weekly summary in a project's channel. {{author}} is the username of the person who built it; {{shapers}} is the list of usernames of the people whose comments shaped it, already joined.

group.credits.builtBackedShaped.text: Built by {{author}}, backed by {{backers}}, shaped by {{shapers}}.
group.credits.builtBackedShaped.description: Sentence that names who made a change that went live, on an activity line or the weekly summary in a project's channel. {{author}} is the username of the person who built it; {{backers}} is the joined list of usernames of the people who voted for it; {{shapers}} is the joined list of those whose comments shaped it.

group.credits.backed.description: Sentence that names who made a change that went live, on an activity line or the weekly summary in a project's channel, when the builder is not named. {{backers}} is the list of usernames of the people who voted for it, already joined.

group.credits.backedShaped.description: Sentence that names who made a change that went live, on an activity line or the weekly summary in a project's channel, when the builder is not named. {{backers}} is the joined list of usernames of the people who voted for it; {{shapers}} is the joined list of those whose comments shaped it.

group.credits.shaped.description: Sentence that names who made a change that went live, on an activity line or the weekly summary in a project's channel, when only the people whose comments shaped it are named. {{shapers}} is the list of their usernames, already joined.

group.weekly.title.description: Heading of the weekly summary card posted in a project's channel, and the card's one-line text. {{app}} is the project's name.

group.weekly.titleNoApp.description: One-line text of the weekly summary card posted in a project's channel when the project's name is not known.

group.weekly.nothingLanded.description: Subheading on the weekly summary card posted in a project's channel when no change went live this week. 'Landed' means was released.

group.weekly.wentLive_one.description: Subheading on the weekly summary card posted in a project's channel, above the list of changes released this week. {{count}} is how many. 'Change' is a noun.

group.weekly.wentLive_other.description: Subheading on the weekly summary card posted in a project's channel, above the list of changes released this week. {{count}} is how many. 'Changes' is a noun.

group.weekly.authorBacked.description: After a change's title on the weekly summary card posted in a project's channel, following a middle dot. {{author}} is the username of the person who built the change; {{backers}} is the joined list of usernames of the people who voted for it.

group.weekly.moreLive_other.description: Last line of the list of changes released this week on the weekly summary card posted in a project's channel: {{count}} further changes went live that the card does not list. Lower case, it continues the list.

group.weekly.waiting_one.text: One change is waiting for approval

group.weekly.waiting_other.description: Subheading on the weekly summary card posted in a project's channel, above the list of changes waiting for the community's vote. {{count}} is how many.

group.weekly.moreWaiting_one.description: Last line of the list of changes waiting for approval on the weekly summary card posted in a project's channel: {{count}} further changes are waiting that the card does not list. Lower case, it continues the list.

group.weekly.moreWaiting_other.description: Last line of the list of changes waiting for approval on the weekly summary card posted in a project's channel: {{count}} further changes are waiting that the card does not list. Lower case, it continues the list.
