group.attachment.download.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the download control on a file attached to a chat message. {{file}} is the file's name. Download is a verb.

group.attachment.view.description: Tooltip of a Markdown file attached to a chat message: clicking its name opens the file for reading in the side panel. {{file}} is the file's name. View is a verb.

group.attachment.previewTitle.description: Tooltip of the Preview link on an HTML file attached to a chat message: opens the page in a new tab, isolated ('sandboxed') so it cannot touch the person's account. {{file}} is the file's name. Open is a verb.

group.attachment.preview.description: Link on an HTML file attached to a chat message: opens the page in a new tab to look at it. A verb here.

group.row.editTitle.description: Tooltip of the pencil button that appears on the person's own chat message: starts editing that message. A verb.

group.row.edit.description: Accessible name of the pencil button that appears on the person's own chat message: starts editing that message.

group.row.savedTitle.description: Tooltip of the bookmark button on a chat message the person has saved: clicking removes it from their saved items.

group.row.saveTitle.description: Tooltip of the bookmark button on a chat message: clicking keeps the message in the person's notifications list so they can find it later. Save is a verb.

group.row.unsave.description: Accessible name of the bookmark button on a chat message the person has saved: removes it from their saved items.

group.row.save.description: Accessible name of the bookmark button on a chat message: keeps the message in the person's saved items. Save is a verb, to bookmark.

group.row.reactTitle.description: Tooltip of the smiley button on a chat message: opens the emoji to react to the message with. A verb.

group.row.addReaction.description: Accessible name of the smiley button on a chat message: opens the emoji to react to the message with.

group.row.repeated_one.text: Posted {{count}} times in a row; this is the latest
group.row.repeated_one.description: Tooltip of the ×N mark after an automatic line that was posted several times running and is shown once, in a chat and among the replies on a request's or a change's page. {{count}} is how many times. Posted is a verb form.

group.row.repeated_other.text: Posted {{count}} times in a row; this is the latest
group.row.repeated_other.description: Tooltip of the ×N mark after an automatic line that was posted several times running and is shown once, in a chat and among the replies on a request's or a change's page. {{count}} is how many times. Posted is a verb form.

group.row.unreadMention.description: Accessible name of the dot before the author of a chat message that mentions the person and that they have not read yet.

group.row.edited.description: Small muted word after a chat message's time when its author changed the message after sending it. Lower case.

group.row.deleted.description: Shown in place of a chat message's content after its author deleted it.

group.specCard.sharedBy.description: Line on the card of a spec (the written description of a change) that someone shared in a chat. {{name}} is that person's username, inside the <0> tags; {{version}} is the spec's version number, and 'v' abbreviates version. Shared is a verb form.

group.specCard.sharedByBuilt.description: Line on the card of a spec that someone shared in a chat. {{name}} is that person's username, inside the <0> tags; {{version}} is the spec's version number, and 'v' abbreviates version; {{built}} is the date and time the change was built, already formatted.

group.specCard.sharedByPr.description: Line on the card of a spec that someone shared in a chat. {{name}} is that person's username, inside the <0> tags; {{version}} is the spec's version number, and 'v' abbreviates version; the <1> link opens the pull request, and {{number}} is its number. PR is the usual abbreviation of pull request.

group.specCard.sharedByBuiltPr.description: Line on the card of a spec that someone shared in a chat. {{name}} is that person's username, inside the <0> tags; {{version}} is the spec's version number; {{built}} is the date and time the change was built, already formatted; the <1> link opens the pull request, and {{number}} is its number. PR abbreviates pull request.

group.specCard.loading.description: Replaces the label of the 'View full spec' button on a shared spec's card while the spec is being fetched.

group.specCard.view.description: Button on the card of a spec shared in a chat: opens the whole spec in the side panel. View is a verb.

group.menu.makeRequest.description: Item in a chat message's menu: asks Homeroom bot to treat the message as a request to build something for the project. 'Request' is a noun.

group.menu.viewThread.description: Item in a chat message's menu, when the message already has replies: opens the thread of replies under it.

group.menu.replyInThread.description: Item in a chat message's menu, when the message has no replies yet: opens a thread under the message to reply there. Reply is a verb.

group.menu.edit.description: Item in the menu of the person's own chat message: starts editing it.

group.menu.copyText.description: Item in a chat message's menu: copies the message's text to the clipboard. Copy is a verb.

group.menu.textCopied.description: Brief notice after 'Copy text' in a chat message's menu: the message's text is on the clipboard.

group.menu.copyLink.description: Item in a chat message's menu: copies a web link that opens the chat at this message. Copy is a verb.

group.menu.linkCopied.description: Brief notice after 'Copy link to message' in a chat message's menu: the link is on the clipboard.

group.menu.markUnread.description: Item in the menu of someone else's chat message: marks the channel as unread from this message on, so it shows as new again. Mark is a verb.

group.menu.markedUnread.description: Brief notice after 'Mark unread' in a chat message's menu: the channel now shows as unread from that message.

group.menu.markUnreadFailed.description: Brief notice when 'Mark unread' in a chat message's menu failed. 'This' is the message.

group.menu.delete.description: Item in the menu of the person's own chat message: asks for confirmation, then deletes the message for everyone.

group.menu.deleteFailed.description: Brief notice when deleting the person's own chat message failed.

group.menu.report.description: Item in the menu of someone else's chat message: opens the form that reports the message to the moderators. Report is a verb.

group.menu.block.description: Item in the menu of someone else's chat message: asks for confirmation, then hides that person's messages from the reader. {{username}} is the author's username; keep the @ before it. Block is a verb.

group.menu.blockFailed.description: Alert shown when blocking a chat message's author failed and the server gave no reason. Block is a verb: to hide a person's messages.

group.deleteConfirm.title.description: Title of the confirmation dialog before the person's own chat message is deleted.

group.deleteConfirm.message.text: Everyone will see “Message deleted” in its place. This can’t be undone.
group.deleteConfirm.message.description: Body of the confirmation dialog before the person's own chat message is deleted. “Message deleted” is the exact text shown where the message was; translate it the same way as that text.

group.deleteConfirm.confirm.description: Confirm button of the dialog that asks whether to delete the person's own chat message. A verb.

group.blockConfirm.title.description: Title of the confirmation dialog before a chat message's author is blocked. {{username}} is that person's username; keep the @ before it. Block is a verb: to hide a person's messages.

group.blockConfirm.message.text: Their messages in Messages and app discussions will be hidden.
group.blockConfirm.message.description: Body of the confirmation dialog before a person is blocked from a chat message's menu. The second 'Messages' is the name of the Messages tab; 'app discussions' are the projects' channels.

group.blockConfirm.confirm.description: Confirm button of the dialog that asks whether to block a chat message's author. A verb: to hide a person's messages.

group.report.label.description: Names what is being reported, at the top of the report form opened from a chat message. {{username}} is the message author's username; keep the @ before it.

group.sheet.reply.description: Item on the sheet that opens when a chat message is pressed and held on a touch screen: starts a reply to that message. A verb.

group.sheet.unsave.description: Item on the sheet that opens when a saved chat message is pressed and held: removes the message from the person's saved items.

group.sheet.save.description: Item on the sheet that opens when a chat message is pressed and held: keeps the message in the person's saved items. A verb, to bookmark; not saving a form.

group.thread.replies_one.description: Divider under the first message of an open thread in a chat: how many replies follow. {{count}} is that number. Reply is a noun.

group.thread.replies_other.description: Divider under the first message of an open thread in a chat: how many replies follow. {{count}} is that number. Replies is a noun.

group.thread.noReplies.description: Divider under the first message of an open thread in a chat that nobody has replied to.

group.history.loadEarlier.description: Button at the top of a discussion's messages: fetches the older messages before the ones shown. Load is a verb.

group.composer.replyingToPlatform.description: Line above the message box in a community chat while the person is writing a reply to an automatic line that Homeroom itself posted, such as a change being put up for a vote. Keep the arrow first.

group.composer.replyingToMessage.description: Line above the message box in a community chat while the person is writing a reply to a message whose author is no longer known. Keep the arrow first.

group.quiet.app.inviteUnnamed.text: 👋 Say hi, ask a question, or share what you would like to see next in this app.
group.quiet.app.inviteUnnamed.description: Line under the heading of the empty-channel card of a project whose name is not known, for a person who may write. Keep the waving hand first.

group.quiet.app.readOnlyUnnamed.text: Messages from the people building this app will show up here.
group.quiet.app.readOnlyUnnamed.description: Line under the heading of the empty-channel card of a project whose name is not known, for a person who may read but not write.

group.typing.one.description: Status line under the messages of a chat while one other person is typing. {{name}} is their username.

group.typing.several.description: Status line under the messages of a chat while several other people are typing. {{names}} is their usernames, already joined into a list.

group.send.notSentReason.description: Brief notice when a chat message was refused. {{reason}} is the server's own complete sentence saying why, for example that the channel has moved.

group.send.notSentJoin.text: Not sent. Join this project to post here.
group.send.notSentJoin.description: Brief notice when a chat message was refused because the person is not a member of the project. Join and post are verbs: become a member, send a message.

group.send.rateLimited_one.text: Not sent. You're sending messages too fast. Try again in {{count}} second.
group.send.rateLimited_one.description: Brief notice when a chat message was refused because the person sent too many in a short time. {{count}} is the number of seconds to wait.

group.send.rateLimited_other.text: Not sent. You're sending messages too fast. Try again in {{count}} seconds.
group.send.rateLimited_other.description: Brief notice when a chat message was refused because the person sent too many in a short time. {{count}} is the number of seconds to wait.

group.send.rateLimitedMoment.text: Not sent. You're sending messages too fast. Try again in a moment.
group.send.rateLimitedMoment.description: Brief notice when a chat message was refused because the person sent too many in a short time, and the wait is not known.

group.send.error.description: Brief notice when the chat connection reported an error and gave no explanation of its own.

group.send.notSentError.text: Not sent. Something went wrong. Try again.
group.send.notSentError.description: Brief notice when a chat message could not be delivered because its channel moved, and the server gave no explanation of its own.

group.systemSender.description: Stands in for the author's name on a chat line that no person wrote, such as an automatic notice, when the project's name is not available. A noun: the platform itself.

group.history.failed.description: Error line in a project's channel when its messages could not be fetched. A 'Try again' button follows it.

group.thread.readOnly.description: Notice in place of the message box of a discussion thread the person may read but not write in.

group.thread.placeholder.description: Placeholder inside the empty message box of a discussion thread. Reply is a verb.

group.thread.empty.text: No messages yet. Start the thread.
group.thread.empty.description: Line shown in a discussion thread that has no messages. Start is a verb: write the first message.

group.thread.loading.description: Line shown in a discussion thread while its messages are being fetched.

group.thread.failed.description: Error line in a discussion thread when its messages could not be fetched. A 'Try again' button follows it.

group.thread.unknownAuthor.description: Stands where a person's username is shown on the card under a chat message that previews the newest reply in its thread, when the reply's author is not known. Shown alone in the name's own element; lower case in English, like a username.

group.quote.spec.description: Stands in for the text of a shared spec that has no title, in the preview of the message being replied to above the chat message box. A spec is the written description of a change.

group.quote.file.description: Stands in for an attached file's name when it has none, after a paperclip, in the preview of the message being replied to above the chat message box. A noun, lower case.

group.bookmark.saveFailed.description: Brief notice when bookmarking a chat message failed. Save means keep it in the person's saved items.

group.bookmark.unsaveFailed.description: Brief notice when removing a chat message from the person's saved items failed.

group.bot.askFailed.text: Couldn’t ask Homeroom bot just now.
group.bot.askFailed.description: Brief notice when 'Make this a request' on a chat message could not reach Homeroom bot, the product's assistant that builds changes. Keep the name Homeroom bot.

group.row.editedAt.description: Tooltip of the 'edited' mark on a chat message. {{when}} is the date and time of the last edit, already formatted, for example Jun 16, 2026, 02:41 PM. Lower case.

group.row.editedTooltip.description: Tooltip of the 'edited' mark on a chat message when the time of the edit is not known. Lower case.

group.edit.notConnected.text: Not connected. Your edit wasn’t sent, so try again in a moment.
group.edit.notConnected.description: Notice beside the Save and Cancel buttons while editing a chat message, when the change could not be sent because the connection is down. 'Edit' is a noun here: the changed message.

group.report.selected.description: Names what is being reported, at the top of the report form opened from the reaction bar of a chat message on a touch screen.

group.attach.tooBig.image.text: "{{file}}" is too big. Images max {{megabytes}} MB.
group.attach.tooBig.image.description: Error above the chat message box when a picture chosen to attach is over the size limit. {{file}} is the file's name; {{megabytes}} is the limit in megabytes. Keep the quotation marks around the name.

group.attach.tooBig.markdown.text: "{{file}}" is too big. Markdown files max {{kilobytes}} KB.
group.attach.tooBig.markdown.description: Error above the chat message box when a Markdown file chosen to attach is over the size limit. {{file}} is the file's name; {{kilobytes}} is the limit in kilobytes. Keep the quotation marks around the name.

group.attach.tooBig.html.text: "{{file}}" is too big. HTML files max {{megabytes}} MB.
group.attach.tooBig.html.description: Error above the chat message box when an HTML file chosen to attach is over the size limit. {{file}} is the file's name; {{megabytes}} is the limit in megabytes. Keep the quotation marks around the name.

group.attach.tooBig.other.text: "{{file}}" is too big. Files max {{megabytes}} MB.
group.attach.tooBig.other.description: Error above the chat message box when a file chosen to attach is over the size limit for files in general. {{file}} is the file's name; {{megabytes}} is the limit in megabytes. Keep the quotation marks around the name.

group.attach.maxPerMessage_one.description: Error above the chat message box when more files were chosen than one message may carry. {{count}} is the limit.

group.attach.maxPerMessage_other.description: Error above the chat message box when more files were chosen than one message may carry. {{count}} is the limit.

group.attach.uploadFailedStatus.description: Error above the chat message box when a file could not be uploaded and the server gave no reason. {{status}} is the HTTP status code, a number such as 500.

group.attach.uploadFailed.description: Error above the chat message box when a file could not be uploaded and nothing more is known.

group.attach.stillUploading.description: Notice above the chat message box when Send was pressed while an attached file is still uploading; the message is not sent yet.

group.file.loadFailedStatus.description: Shown in the side panel when a Markdown file attached to a chat message could not be fetched for viewing. {{file}} is the file's name; {{status}} is the HTTP status code, a number such as 404.

group.file.loadFailed.description: Shown in the side panel when a Markdown file attached to a chat message could not be fetched for viewing and nothing more is known.

group.spec.title.description: Title of a shared spec that has no title of its own, on its card in the chat and in the side panel. {{version}} is the spec's version number; 'v' abbreviates version. A spec is the written description of a change.

group.spec.previewTitle.description: Title shown in the side panel's header while a shared spec with no title of its own is being fetched. {{version}} is the spec's version number; 'v' abbreviates version. Lower case.

group.spec.someone.description: Stands in for the username of the person who shared a spec in a chat when it is not known, in 'Shared by …' on the spec's card.

group.spec.gone.text: This spec is no longer available. The sharer may have deleted the session.
group.spec.gone.description: Shown in the side panel when a spec shared in a chat no longer exists. 'The sharer' is the person who shared it; a 'session' is the piece of work with the AI builder that the spec belonged to.

group.spec.loadFailed.description: Shown in the side panel when a spec shared in a chat could not be fetched. {{status}} is the HTTP status code, a number such as 500.

group.spec.empty.description: Shown in the side panel in place of the content of a shared spec that has no content. Keep the parentheses.

group.spec.error.description: Shown in the side panel when fetching a shared spec failed. {{message}} is the browser's own technical error message.

group.spec.loading.description: Shown in the side panel in place of a shared spec's content while it is being fetched again after the page was reloaded.

group.status.reconnecting.description: Status line under the messages of a project's channel while the connection to the chat is down and being restored.

group.status.reconnectingQueued_one.description: Status line under the messages of a project's channel while the connection is down. {{count}} is how many of the person's messages are waiting to be sent once it is back.

group.status.reconnectingQueued_other.description: Status line under the messages of a project's channel while the connection is down. {{count}} is how many of the person's messages are waiting to be sent once it is back.

group.ref.byUser.description: Stands in for the title of a proposed change that has none, in the list of changes offered while typing # in a chat message. {{username}} is the username of the person who proposed it. Lower case.

global.screen.label.description: Accessible name of the screen of Global Chat, the experimental screen for chatting with Homeroom's assistant.

global.toolbar.title.description: Heading of Global Chat, the experimental screen for chatting with Homeroom's assistant. The <0> tags mute the part in parentheses; keep them around it.

global.toolbar.saved.description: Line under the heading of Global Chat, the experimental screen for chatting with Homeroom's assistant: the conversation is kept and can be found again under the Messages tab. Messages is that tab's name.

global.toolbar.closeChat.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the Close button in the header of Global Chat, the experimental screen for chatting with Homeroom's assistant: leaves the chat and returns to the previous screen. Close is a verb.

global.toolbar.close.description: Button in the header of Global Chat, the experimental screen for chatting with Homeroom's assistant: leaves the chat and returns to the previous screen. A verb.

global.toolbar.startNew.description: Accessible name of the New button in the header of Global Chat, the experimental screen for chatting with Homeroom's assistant: begins a fresh conversation with the assistant.

global.toolbar.newChat.description: Tooltip of the New button in the header of Global Chat, the experimental screen for chatting with Homeroom's assistant: begins a fresh conversation with the assistant.

global.toolbar.new.description: Button in the header of Global Chat, the experimental screen for chatting with Homeroom's assistant: begins a fresh conversation. Short for 'new chat'.

global.budget.title.text: Global Chat spend this month and overall OpenRouter allowance
global.budget.title.description: Tooltip of the spending figures in the header of Global Chat, the experimental screen for chatting with Homeroom's assistant: what the chat has cost this month, and what is left of the account's allowance with OpenRouter, the AI provider. Global Chat is the feature's name.

global.budget.spent.description: Spending figure in the header of Global Chat, the experimental screen for chatting with Homeroom's assistant. {{spent}} is what the chat has cost this month, as an amount in dollars such as $0.42.

global.budget.spentCap.description: Spending figure in the header of Global Chat, the experimental screen for chatting with Homeroom's assistant. {{spent}} is what the chat has cost this month and {{cap}} the monthly limit, both amounts in dollars such as $0.42.

global.budget.spentLeft.description: Spending figure in the header of Global Chat, the experimental screen for chatting with Homeroom's assistant. {{spent}} is what the chat has cost this month; {{remaining}} is what is left of the account's overall allowance. Both are amounts in dollars such as $0.42.

global.budget.spentCapLeft.description: Spending figure in the header of Global Chat, the experimental screen for chatting with Homeroom's assistant. {{spent}} is what the chat has cost this month, {{cap}} the monthly limit, and {{remaining}} what is left of the account's overall allowance. All are amounts in dollars such as $0.42.

global.progress.label.description: Accessible name of the progress box shown in Global Chat, the experimental screen for chatting with Homeroom's assistant while the assistant is working on an answer. Global Chat is the feature's name.

global.progress.elapsed_one.description: Timer in the progress box of Global Chat while the assistant works: seconds elapsed so far. {{count}} is the number; s abbreviates seconds.

global.progress.elapsed_other.description: Timer in the progress box of Global Chat while the assistant works: seconds elapsed so far. {{count}} is the number; s abbreviates seconds.

global.progress.activity.description: Label of the fold in the progress box of Global Chat that opens the list of steps the assistant has taken so far. A noun.

global.progress.model.description: Line in the details of Global Chat's progress box. {{model}} is the technical name of the AI model answering.

global.progress.reasoning.description: Line in the details of Global Chat's progress box: how much reasoning the AI model was asked to do. {{effort}} is the setting's value as the server sends it, an English word such as low, medium or high.

global.progress.attempt.description: Line in the details of Global Chat's progress box, shown from the second try on. {{number}} is which try this is, for example 2.

global.progress.understanding.description: First step shown in the progress box of Global Chat after the person sends a message, while the assistant reads it.

global.progress.reconnecting.description: Step shown in the progress box of Global Chat when the connection dropped mid-answer and the chat is fetching the answer the server kept. A 'turn' is one question and its answer.

global.suggestions.label.description: Accessible name of the row of suggestion buttons under an answer in Global Chat, the experimental screen for chatting with Homeroom's assistant.

global.suggestions.holdTitle.description: Tooltip of a suggestion button in Global Chat that has related suggestions: pressing and holding it opens them. Hold is a verb.

global.suggestions.more.description: Button at the end of the row of suggestions in Global Chat: asks the assistant for further suggestions.

global.suggestions.relatedLabel.description: Accessible name of the menu of related suggestions that opens when a suggestion button in Global Chat is held. {{suggestion}} is that button's label.

global.suggestions.holdHint.text: Hold an option for related suggestions.
global.suggestions.holdHint.description: Hint above the first suggestions in an empty Global Chat: pressing and holding a suggestion opens related ones. Hold is a verb.

global.turn.moreSuggestions.description: Shown as the person's own message in Global Chat's transcript after they press the 'More suggestions' button.

global.result.loading.description: Accessible name of the spinner shown in a Global Chat answer while one of its result cards is being fetched.

global.composer.placeholder.description: Placeholder inside the empty message box of Global Chat. Homeroom is the product's name.

global.composer.placeholderUnavailable.description: Placeholder inside the disabled message box of Global Chat when the account has no key for OpenRouter, the AI provider it needs.

global.composer.label.description: Accessible name of the message box of Global Chat. Message is a verb here: write to. Global Chat is the feature's name.

global.composer.stopLabel.description: Accessible name of the round button beside the message box of Global Chat while the assistant is answering: stops the answer. Stop is a verb.

global.composer.sendLabel.description: Accessible name of the round button beside the message box of Global Chat: sends what the person typed.

global.composer.stop.description: Tooltip of the round button beside the message box of Global Chat while the assistant is answering: stops the answer. A verb.

global.composer.send.description: Tooltip of the round button beside the message box of Global Chat: sends what the person typed. A verb.

global.unavailable.disabledTitle.description: Heading shown in Global Chat when the feature is switched off for the account. Global Chat is the feature's name.

global.unavailable.noModelTitle.description: Heading shown in Global Chat when the account has no key for OpenRouter, the AI provider: typed questions cannot be answered without it.

global.unavailable.disabledBody.text: Global Chat is an optional experimental feature.
global.unavailable.disabledBody.description: Line under 'Enable Global Chat to start' in Global Chat. Global Chat is the feature's name.

global.unavailable.noModelBody.text: The direct options below still work without it.
global.unavailable.noModelBody.description: Line under 'Free-form chat needs OpenRouter' in Global Chat: the suggestion buttons below can be used without an OpenRouter key. 'It' is OpenRouter.

global.unavailable.openSettings.description: Button in Global Chat when it cannot be used yet: leaves the chat and opens the Settings page where it is switched on or the key is added. Open is a verb.

global.unavailable.useClassic.description: Button in Global Chat when it cannot be used yet: leaves the chat for the ordinary screens of Homeroom, which the chat calls Classic.

global.history.earlier.description: Button at the top of the Global Chat transcript: fetches the older messages of this conversation.

global.devSettings.requestFailedStatus.description: Error on the Development AI settings card that Global Chat shows inline when a request to the server failed and it gave no reason. {{status}} is the HTTP status code, a number such as 500.

global.devSettings.loadFailed.text: Development AI settings could not be loaded.
global.devSettings.loadFailed.description: Error on the Development AI settings card that Global Chat shows inline when the current settings could not be fetched.

global.devSettings.chooseModel.description: Error on the Development AI settings card that Global Chat shows inline when Save is pressed with OpenRouter chosen and no model picked. OpenRouter is the AI provider's name.

global.devSettings.savingStatus.description: Status line under the Save button on the Development AI settings card that Global Chat shows inline while the settings are being saved.

global.devSettings.saving.description: Replaces the label of the 'Save development AI' button on the Development AI settings card that Global Chat shows inline while the settings are being saved.

global.devSettings.saved.description: Status line on the Development AI settings card that Global Chat shows inline after the OpenRouter settings were saved.

global.devSettings.claudeDefault.text: Claude Code is now the default development AI.
global.devSettings.claudeDefault.description: Status line on the Development AI settings card that Global Chat shows inline after Claude Code was saved as the AI that builds changes. Claude Code is a product name.

global.devSettings.saveFailed.text: Development AI settings could not be saved.
global.devSettings.saveFailed.description: Error on the Development AI settings card that Global Chat shows inline when saving failed and the server gave no reason.

global.devSettings.loading.description: Shown in place of the Development AI settings card that Global Chat shows inline while the current settings are being fetched.

global.devSettings.backendLabel.description: Label of the first select on the Development AI settings card that Global Chat shows inline: which AI service builds changes for this person (OpenRouter or Claude Code).

global.devSettings.modelLabel.description: Label of the select on the Development AI settings card that Global Chat shows inline that picks the AI model used to build changes.

global.devSettings.modelRecommended.description: Option in the Model select on the Development AI settings card that Global Chat shows inline, for the model Homeroom recommends. {{model}} is the model's name.

global.devSettings.modelRecommendedFavor.description: Option in the Model select on the Development AI settings card that Global Chat shows inline, for the recommended model when it is also one of the person's favourites. {{model}} is the model's name; keep the star.

global.devSettings.effortLabel.description: Label of the select on the Development AI settings card that Global Chat shows inline that sets how much the AI model reasons before answering.

global.devSettings.effort.default.description: Option of the 'Reasoning effort' select on the Development AI settings card: leave the amount of reasoning to the model's own default.

global.devSettings.effort.minimal.description: Option of the 'Reasoning effort' select on the Development AI settings card: the least reasoning.

global.devSettings.effort.low.description: Option of the 'Reasoning effort' select on the Development AI settings card: little reasoning.

global.devSettings.effort.medium.description: Option of the 'Reasoning effort' select on the Development AI settings card: a middling amount of reasoning.

global.devSettings.effort.high.description: Option of the 'Reasoning effort' select on the Development AI settings card: much reasoning.

global.devSettings.effort.xhigh.description: Option of the 'Reasoning effort' select on the Development AI settings card: the most reasoning.

global.devSettings.unavailable.text: OpenRouter development AI is unavailable for this account.
global.devSettings.unavailable.description: Note on the Development AI settings card that Global Chat shows inline when the account cannot use OpenRouter to build changes. OpenRouter is the AI provider's name.

global.devSettings.save.description: Button on the Development AI settings card that Global Chat shows inline: saves which AI builds changes and its model. Save is a verb.

global.devSettings.note.text: This changes development work only. It does not change the Global Chat model.
global.devSettings.note.description: Note at the bottom of the Development AI settings card that Global Chat shows inline: the choice applies to building changes, not to the model that answers in the chat. Global Chat is the feature's name.

global.activity.loadingOptions.description: Status line in Global Chat after 'More suggestions' was pressed, while further suggestions are fetched.

global.activity.thinking.description: Status line in Global Chat just after the person sent a message, while the assistant prepares its answer.

global.activity.working.description: Status line in Global Chat while the assistant runs a step that has no name of its own.

global.activity.preparingConfirmation.description: Status line in Global Chat while the assistant prepares the card that asks the person to confirm an action.

global.activity.reconnecting.description: Status line in Global Chat when the connection dropped mid-answer and is being restored.

global.activity.loading.description: Status line in Global Chat after a suggestion or a result button was pressed, while its answer is fetched.

global.activity.applying.description: Status line in Global Chat after Confirm was pressed, while the confirmed action is carried out.

global.error.request.text: Global Chat could not complete that request.
global.error.request.description: Error line at the bottom of the Global Chat transcript, with a Retry button: something failed and nothing more is known. Global Chat is the feature's name.

global.error.unavailable.description: Error line at the bottom of the Global Chat transcript, with a Retry button: the chat could not be started. Global Chat is the feature's name.

global.error.loadChat.description: Error line at the bottom of the Global Chat transcript, with a Retry button: the chosen conversation could not be fetched.

global.error.enableFirst.text: Enable experimental Global Chat in Settings first.
global.error.enableFirst.description: Error line at the bottom of the Global Chat transcript, with a Retry button: the feature is switched off for the account. Settings is the page's name. Global Chat is the feature's name.

global.error.needKey.text: Add or claim an OpenRouter key in Settings to use Global Chat.
global.error.needKey.description: Error line at the bottom of the Global Chat transcript, with a Retry button: the account has no key for OpenRouter, the AI provider. 'Claim' means take the free key Homeroom offers. Global Chat is the feature's name.

global.error.turnFailed.text: That request could not be completed.
global.error.turnFailed.description: Error line at the bottom of the Global Chat transcript, with a Retry button: the assistant failed to answer and gave no explanation of its own.

global.error.interrupted.text: The connection was interrupted before an answer was saved. Please try again.
global.error.interrupted.description: Error line at the bottom of the Global Chat transcript, with a Retry button: the connection dropped and no answer could be recovered.

global.error.directAction.text: That direct action could not be completed.
global.error.directAction.description: Error line at the bottom of the Global Chat transcript, with a Retry button: a suggestion or result button's action failed. A 'direct action' is one that runs without asking the AI model.

global.error.openFirst.description: Error under a result card in Global Chat when one of its buttons was pressed with no conversation open. Open is a verb. Global Chat is the feature's name.

global.error.loadEarlier.description: Error line at the bottom of the Global Chat transcript, with a Retry button: the older messages of the conversation could not be fetched.

global.error.startNew.text: Could not start a new chat.
global.error.startNew.description: Error line at the bottom of the Global Chat transcript, with a Retry button: a fresh conversation could not be created.

global.error.action.text: That action could not be completed.
global.error.action.description: Error line at the bottom of the Global Chat transcript, with a Retry button: the action the person confirmed failed and the server gave no reason.

global.error.browserActionUnavailable.description: Error line at the bottom of the Global Chat transcript, with a Retry button: the assistant proposed an action for the browser to carry out that the chat refuses as unsafe or unknown.

global.error.browserActionNoTarget.text: That browser action is missing its target.
global.error.browserActionNoTarget.description: Error line at the bottom of the Global Chat transcript, with a Retry button: the assistant proposed an action for the browser to carry out without saying what to act on.

global.error.localSettingUnavailable.description: Error line at the bottom of the Global Chat transcript, with a Retry button: the assistant proposed changing a setting kept on this device that the chat does not know.

global.error.actionFailedStatus.description: Error line at the bottom of the Global Chat transcript, with a Retry button: an action the browser carried out for the assistant was refused and the server gave no reason. {{status}} is the HTTP status code, a number such as 403.

global.error.handoffNoApp.text: That development handoff is missing its app.
global.error.handoffNoApp.description: Error line at the bottom of the Global Chat transcript, with a Retry button: the assistant tried to open a building session without naming the project it is for. A 'handoff' passes the task from the chat to the building agent.

global.error.browserAction.text: That browser action could not be completed.
global.error.browserAction.description: Error line at the bottom of the Global Chat transcript, with a Retry button: an action the browser carried out for the assistant failed.

global.error.requestFailedStatus.description: Error shown in Global Chat or its settings when a request to the server failed and it gave no reason. {{status}} is the HTTP status code, a number such as 500.

global.error.chatRequestFailedStatus.description: Error line at the bottom of the Global Chat transcript, with a Retry button: sending the message failed and the server gave no reason. {{status}} is the HTTP status code, a number such as 500. Global Chat is the feature's name.

global.kind.app.description: Heading of a result card in a Global Chat answer, and the name used for an item of that kind that has no title: an app (project) on Homeroom.

global.kind.issue.description: Heading of a result card in a Global Chat answer, and the name used for an item of that kind that has no title: a request, something people asked to have built or fixed. A noun.

global.kind.proposal.description: Heading of a result card in a Global Chat answer, and the name used for an item of that kind that has no title: a proposed change waiting for the community's vote. A noun.

global.kind.session.description: Heading of a result card in a Global Chat answer, and the name used for an item of that kind that has no title: a piece of building work in progress with the AI builder. A noun.

global.kind.conversation.description: Heading of a result card in a Global Chat answer, and the name used for an item of that kind that has no title: a conversation in Messages.

global.kind.notification.description: Heading of a result card in a Global Chat answer, and the name used for an item of that kind that has no title: one of the person's notifications.

global.kind.profile.description: Heading of a result card in a Global Chat answer, and the name used for an item of that kind that has no title: a person's profile.

global.kind.leaderboard.description: Heading of a result card in a Global Chat answer, and the name used for an item of that kind that has no title: the ranking of contributors.

global.kind.challenge.description: Heading of a result card in a Global Chat answer, and the name used for an item of that kind that has no title: a challenge, a task with a reward that people can take on. A noun.

global.kind.wallet.description: Heading of a result card in a Global Chat answer, and the name used for an item of that kind that has no title: the person's wallet of tokens.

global.kind.staking.description: Heading of a result card in a Global Chat answer, and the name used for an item of that kind that has no title: tokens the person has staked (locked up to earn rewards).

global.kind.setting.description: Heading of a result card in a Global Chat answer, and the name used for an item of that kind that has no title: a setting of the person's account. A noun.

global.kind.adminRecord.description: Heading of a result card in a Global Chat answer, and the name used for an item of that kind that has no title: a record from the administrators' console. Short for administration.

global.kind.result.description: Heading of a result card in a Global Chat answer, and the name used for an item of that kind that has no title: a result of no particular kind. A noun.

global.kind.error.description: Heading of a result card in a Global Chat answer, and the name used for an item of that kind that has no title: an error the assistant ran into.

global.kind.form.description: Heading of a result card in a Global Chat answer, and the name used for an item of that kind that has no title: a form to fill in. A noun.

global.kind.results.description: Heading of a result card in a Global Chat answer, and the name used for an item of that kind that has no title: a list of results grouped under headings. A noun.

global.kind.confirmation.description: Heading of a result card in a Global Chat answer, and the name used for an item of that kind that has no title: a request to confirm an action.

global.item.kindWithId.description: Title of a row on a result card in Global Chat when the item has no title of its own. {{kind}} is what the item is, already in the reader's language (for example Request or Proposal); {{id}} is its number or identifier.

global.item.selectRequest.description: Accessible name of a row on a result card in Global Chat when pressing the row runs an action on it, and the text shown as the person's own message after they press it. {{action}} is the action's name as the assistant gave it, for example 'Open'; {{target}} is the item's title.

global.item.detailsFailed.description: Error under a row of a result card in Global Chat when one of its detail buttons failed and the server gave no reason.

global.item.actionLoading.description: Replaces the label of a button under a row of a result card in Global Chat while that button's details are being fetched.

global.item.loadingSettings.description: Shown under a row of the settings result card in Global Chat while that group of settings is being fetched.

global.openInClassic.description: Button on result cards in Global Chat: leaves the chat and opens the same thing on Homeroom's ordinary screens, which the chat calls Classic. Open is a verb.

global.value.yes.description: Value shown on a result card in Global Chat for a field that is switched on or true.

global.value.no.description: Value shown on a result card in Global Chat for a field that is switched off or false.

global.value.seconds_one.description: Value of 'Active time (7d)' on an app's result card in Global Chat. {{count}} is a number of seconds; sec abbreviates seconds.

global.value.seconds_other.description: Value of 'Active time (7d)' on an app's result card in Global Chat. {{count}} is a number of seconds; sec abbreviates seconds.

global.value.minutes_one.description: Value of 'Active time (7d)' on an app's result card in Global Chat. {{count}} is a number of minutes; min abbreviates minutes.

global.value.minutes_other.description: Value of 'Active time (7d)' on an app's result card in Global Chat. {{count}} is a number of minutes; min abbreviates minutes.

global.value.hours.description: Value of 'Active time (7d)' on an app's result card in Global Chat. {{hours}} is a number of hours already formatted, possibly with one decimal such as 1.5; hr abbreviates hours.

global.result.githubIssues.description: Heading of a result card in Global Chat that lists issues from the project's GitHub repository. GitHub is a product name.

global.result.platformIssues.description: Heading of a result card in Global Chat that lists requests filed on Homeroom itself rather than on GitHub.

global.result.appActivity.description: Heading of a result card in Global Chat that lists apps with how active each has been lately.

global.result.appDiscussions.description: Heading of a result card in Global Chat that lists messages from an app's channel.

global.result.openInClassic.description: Heading of a result card in Global Chat whose only content is a button that opens a page on Homeroom's ordinary screens, which the chat calls Classic. Open is a verb.

global.result.readyToApply.description: Heading of a result card in Global Chat that holds a change the assistant prepared and the person can apply with one button.

global.result.globalChatSettings.description: Heading of the result card in Global Chat that holds the chat's own settings. Global Chat is the feature's name.

global.result.developmentSettings.description: Heading of the result card in Global Chat that holds the settings of the AI that builds changes.

global.result.showMore.description: Button at the bottom of a result card in Global Chat: reveals the next few rows of the list. A down arrow follows it.

global.empty.app.description: Shown on a result card in Global Chat when a search for apps found none.

global.empty.issue.description: Shown on a result card in Global Chat when a search for issues or requests found none.

global.empty.proposal.description: Shown on a result card in Global Chat when no proposed change is waiting for a vote.

global.empty.session.description: Shown on a result card in Global Chat when no building work is in progress.

global.empty.conversation.description: Shown on a result card in Global Chat when a search for conversations found none.

global.empty.notification.description: Shown on a result card in Global Chat when the person has no notifications matching the question.

global.empty.leaderboard.description: Shown on a result card in Global Chat when the ranking of contributors is empty.

global.empty.setting.description: Shown on a result card in Global Chat when a search for settings found none.

global.empty.other.description: Shown on a result card in Global Chat when the assistant looked something up and found nothing.

global.confirm.thisAction.description: Stands in for the name of an action on the confirmation card in Global Chat when the action has no name. Shown alone as the card's bold first line; lower case.

global.confirm.cancelled.description: Replaces a confirmation card in Global Chat after the person pressed Cancel on it: the action was not carried out.

global.confirm.label.description: Accessible name of the card in Global Chat that asks the person to confirm an action before the assistant carries it out. Confirm is a verb.

global.confirm.before.description: Line on the confirmation card in Global Chat: after this time the confirmation expires. {{time}} is a time of day, already formatted, such as 02:41 PM.

global.confirm.confirmed.description: Label of the disabled main button of a confirmation card in Global Chat after the action was confirmed.

global.confirm.confirm.description: Main button of the confirmation card in Global Chat: carries out the action the assistant prepared. A verb.

global.action.details.description: Button under an expanded row of a result card in Global Chat: shows more about that item inside the chat.

global.action.issues.description: Button under an expanded row of a result card in Global Chat, on an app: asks the chat for that app's issues and requests.

global.action.discussions.description: Button under an expanded row of a result card in Global Chat, on an app: asks the chat for the messages in that app's channel.

global.action.comments.description: Button under an expanded row of a result card in Global Chat, on a request: shows the comments on it.

global.action.beforeAfter.description: Button under an expanded row of a result card in Global Chat, on a proposal: shows the screenshots of the app before and after the proposed change.

global.action.checks.description: Button under an expanded row of a result card in Global Chat, on a piece of building work: shows the results of its automated checks (tests). A noun.

global.action.profile.description: Button under an expanded row of a result card in Global Chat, on a leaderboard entry: shows that person's profile.

global.action.mergedWork.description: Button under an expanded row of a result card in Global Chat, on a leaderboard entry: lists that person's changes that were accepted and merged.

global.action.view.description: Button under an expanded row of a result card in Global Chat, on a group of settings: shows the current values of those settings. A verb.

global.request.about.description: Shown as the person's own message in Global Chat's transcript after they press a button on a result card to see an app's details. {{target}} is the app's name.

global.request.issuesFor.description: Shown as the person's own message in Global Chat's transcript after they press a button on a result card to list an app's issues. {{target}} is the app's name.

global.request.discussionsIn.description: Shown as the person's own message in Global Chat's transcript after they press a button on a result card to list the messages in an app's channel. {{target}} is the app's name.

global.request.open.description: Shown as the person's own message in Global Chat's transcript after they press a button on a result card to see an item's details. {{target}} is the item's title. Open is a verb.

global.request.commentsOn.description: Shown as the person's own message in Global Chat's transcript after they press a button on a result card to see the comments on a request. {{target}} is the request's title.

global.request.beforeAfterFor.description: Shown as the person's own message in Global Chat's transcript after they press a button on a result card to see the before and after screenshots of a proposal. {{target}} is the proposal's title.

global.request.detailsFor.description: Shown as the person's own message in Global Chat's transcript after they press a button on a result card to see the details of a piece of building work. {{target}} is its title.

global.request.checksFor.description: Shown as the person's own message in Global Chat's transcript after they press a button on a result card to see the automated check results of a piece of building work. {{target}} is its title. Checks is a noun.

global.request.profileFor.description: Shown as the person's own message in Global Chat's transcript after they press a button on a result card to see a person's profile from the leaderboard. {{target}} is their username.

global.request.mergedWorkBy.description: Shown as the person's own message in Global Chat's transcript after they press a button on a result card to list a person's merged changes from the leaderboard. {{target}} is their username.

global.target.proposal.description: How a proposal is named in Global Chat when its title does not contain its number, in the person's request and in what is sent to the assistant. {{title}} is the proposal's title and {{id}} its number. Proposal is a noun, lower case.

global.target.session.description: How a piece of building work is named in Global Chat when its title does not contain its number. {{title}} is its title and {{id}} its number. Development is a noun, lower case.

global.meta.read.description: Status in the small line under a notification's title on a result card in Global Chat: the notification has been read. An adjective (past participle), not the verb.

global.meta.unread.description: Status in the small line under a notification's title on a result card in Global Chat: the notification has not been read yet.

global.field.messages7d.description: Label of a field in the details of an app on a result card in Global Chat: how many messages were sent in the app's channel in the last seven days. 7d abbreviates seven days.

global.field.activeTime7d.description: Label of a field in the details of an app on a result card in Global Chat: how long people used the app in the last seven days. 7d abbreviates seven days.

global.field.activeUsers.description: Label of a field in the details of an app on a result card in Global Chat: how many people used it recently.

global.field.development.description: Label of a field in the details of an app on the 'Recent app activity' card in Global Chat: how many pieces of building work are in progress. A noun.

global.field.openIssues.description: Label of a field in the details of an app on a result card in Global Chat: how many issues are not yet resolved. Open is an adjective.

global.field.openProposals.description: Label of a field in the details of an app on a result card in Global Chat: how many proposed changes are waiting for a vote. Open is an adjective.

global.field.activeDevelopment.description: Label of a field in the details of an app on a result card in Global Chat: how many pieces of building work are in progress.

global.field.app.description: Label of a field in the details of a proposal or a piece of building work on a result card in Global Chat: the app it belongs to.

global.field.yesVotes.description: Label of a field in the details of a proposal on a result card in Global Chat: the number of votes in favour.

global.field.noVotes.description: Label of a field in the details of a proposal on a result card in Global Chat: the number of votes against.

global.field.checks.description: Label of a field in the details of a proposal or a piece of building work on a result card in Global Chat: the state of its automated checks (tests). A noun.

global.field.phase.description: Label of a field in the details of a piece of building work on a result card in Global Chat: which stage its automated checks have reached.

global.field.unread.description: Label of a field in the details of a conversation on a result card in Global Chat: the number of unread messages in it.

global.field.members.description: Label of a field in the details of a conversation on a result card in Global Chat: the number of people in it.

global.field.from.description: Label of a field in the details of a notification on a result card in Global Chat: the username of the person whose action caused it.

global.field.pr.description: Label of a field in the details of a notification on a result card in Global Chat: the number of the pull request it is about. PR is the usual abbreviation of pull request.

global.field.kudos.description: Label of a field in the details of a leaderboard entry on a result card in Global Chat: how many kudos (thanks from other members) the person received.

global.field.prsRecognized.description: Label of a field in the details of a leaderboard entry on a result card in Global Chat: how many of the person's pull requests received kudos. PR abbreviates pull request.

global.field.merged.description: Label of a field in the details of a leaderboard entry on a result card in Global Chat: how many of the person's recognised pull requests were merged (accepted).

global.field.spentThisMonth.description: Label of a field in the details of the Global Chat usage setting on a result card: what the chat has cost this month.

global.field.monthlyCap.description: Label of a field in the details of the Global Chat usage setting on a result card: the monthly spending limit.

global.field.capRemaining.description: Label of a field in the details of the Global Chat usage setting on a result card: how much of the monthly spending limit is left.

global.field.openRouterRemaining.description: Label of a field in the details of the Global Chat usage setting on a result card: what is left of the account's allowance with OpenRouter, the AI provider.

global.field.model.description: Label of a field in the details of a setting on a result card in Global Chat: the AI model in use.

global.field.reasoning.description: Label of a field in the details of a setting on a result card in Global Chat: how much the AI model reasons before answering.

global.field.enabled.description: Label of a field in the details of a setting on a result card in Global Chat: whether the feature is switched on.

global.field.backend.description: Label of a field in the details of a setting on a result card in Global Chat: which AI service is used.

global.setting.changeLabel.description: Accessible name of the text field in which the person tells Global Chat what to change in a group of settings. {{setting}} is that group's name. Change is a verb.

global.setting.changePlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the text field in which the person tells Global Chat what to change in a group of settings. {{setting}} is that group's name.

global.setting.continue.description: Button beside the text field in which the person told Global Chat what to change in a group of settings: sends the instruction to the assistant, which then asks for confirmation.

global.setting.changeThese.description: Button under a group of settings on a result card in Global Chat: opens a text field to say what should change. Change is a verb.

global.setting.controlsLabel.description: Accessible name of the row of choice buttons under a setting kept on this device (theme, alerts) on a result card in Global Chat. {{setting}} is the setting's name. Change is a verb.

global.setting.theme.system.description: Choice for the Theme setting on a result card in Global Chat: follow the device's light or dark mode.

global.setting.theme.light.description: Choice for the Theme setting on a result card in Global Chat: the light colour scheme.

global.setting.theme.dark.description: Choice for the Theme setting on a result card in Global Chat: the dark colour scheme.

global.setting.alerts.on.description: Choice for the development alerts setting on a result card in Global Chat: alerts are shown.

global.setting.alerts.off.description: Choice for the development alerts setting on a result card in Global Chat: alerts are not shown.

global.setting.devConsole.always.description: Choice for the developer console setting on a result card in Global Chat: the console is always shown.

global.setting.devConsole.errorsOnly.description: Choice for the developer console setting on a result card in Global Chat: the console is shown only when an error happens.

global.setting.adminPreview.on.description: Choice for the administrator's preview setting on a result card in Global Chat: the preview is switched on.

global.setting.adminPreview.off.description: Choice for the administrator's preview setting on a result card in Global Chat: the preview is switched off.

global.setting.notReturned.text: The setting update was not returned.
global.setting.notReturned.description: Error under a setting on a result card in Global Chat when the server did not send back the change to apply.

global.setting.applyFailed.description: Error under a setting on a result card in Global Chat when the chosen value could not be applied on this device.

global.setting.saveFailed.description: Error under a setting on a result card in Global Chat when saving the chosen value failed and nothing more is known.

global.setting.saving.description: Label of the save button under a setting on a result card in Global Chat while the chosen value is being saved.

global.setting.saved.description: Label of the disabled save button under a setting on a result card in Global Chat when the chosen value is the one already saved.

global.setting.save.description: Button under a setting on a result card in Global Chat: saves the chosen value. A verb.

global.clientAction.applying.description: Main button of a result card in Global Chat that holds an action the assistant prepared, while the action is being carried out.

global.clientAction.done.description: Main button of a result card in Global Chat that holds an action the assistant prepared, disabled, after the action was carried out.

global.clientAction.openInClassic.description: Main button of a result card in Global Chat that holds an action the assistant prepared, when the action is opening a page on Homeroom's ordinary screens, which the chat calls Classic. Open is a verb.

global.clientAction.apply.description: Main button of a result card in Global Chat that holds an action the assistant prepared, when the action changes a setting kept on this device. A verb.

global.clientAction.openAgentSession.description: Main button of a result card in Global Chat that holds an action the assistant prepared, when the action is starting building work: opens a new session with the AI building agent, with the task filled in. Open is a verb.

global.clientAction.open.description: Main button of a result card in Global Chat that holds an action the assistant prepared, when the action opens a link in a new tab. A verb.
